S.meta.title: Lewydo™ — Love What You Do · isitudiyo semidlalo esizimele sase-Ukraine
S.meta.desc: I-Lewydo yisitudiyo semidlalo esizimele sabantu ababili sase-Ukraine. U-Vlad ubhala ikhodi, u-Lilya uyaklama. Dlala i-CubePix ne-Orbit Dash lapha ekhasini, futhi uthole yonke imidlalo yethu ku-Google Play.
S.nav.label: Imenyu enkulu
S.lang.title: Ulimi
S.hero.lead: Singo-Vlad no-Lilya. **U-Vlad ubhala ikhodi, u-Lilya uyaklama** — futhi ndawonye senza imidlalo esithanda ukuyidlala nathi.
S.hero.replay: Inhliziyo ye-Lewydo. Thepha ukuze uyakhe kabusha
S.worlds.title: Umdlalo ngamunye ungumhlaba wawo
S.worlds.lead: Ngena udlale khona lapha: ikhasi liyashintsha nomhlaba ngamunye.
S.cp.next: Ukuthandile? Imnyuziyamu yonke yemidwebo ikulindile ku-demo yamahhala.
S.cp.aria: Iphazili encane ye-CubePix: gcwalisa amaseli ngenombolo yekhyubhu yakho
S.od.tag: Imizila emibili. Ukuthepha okukodwa. Konke ukugxuma kusesigqini.
S.od.lead: Umdlalo wesigqi emkhathini ojulile: ukuthepha okukodwa kushintsha umzila, futhi konke ukugxuma kuwela esigqini somculo wethu. Amazinga amahlanu, imodi engapheli, i-Orbit III kanye nebhodi labaholi lomhlaba.
S.od.new: Manje **ngezilimi ezingu-82**. Umdlalo uzikhethela ngokwawo ulimi lwefoni yakho. Lushintshe noma nini ngembulunga kuzilungiselelo.
S.more.title: Okwengeziwe kwa-Lewydo
S.more.lead: Iphazili ezolile yokuhlanganisa, i-clicker enethezekile kanye neziqondiso ezisebenzisanayo zabathuthukisi bemidlalo — konke ku-Google Play.
S.game.imc.d: Hudula. Hlanganisa. Khula. Iphazili ezolile ye-idle yokuhlanganisa enemigomo, imiklomelo yansuku zonke nokuqhubeka kwamakhyubhu okungapheli.
S.game.joints.d: Isiqondiso esisebenzisanayo sama-joint e-Box2D ku-LibGDX, esinezibonelo eziphilayo, opopayi nezixhumanisi eziwusizo. Senziwe ngumthuthukisi we-LibGDX sabathuthukisi be-LibGDX.
S.game.light.d: Dlala nezinhlobo ezine zokukhanya kwe-2D: iphoyinti, ikhoni, uchungechunge nokuqondile. Hambisa amalambu, wenze izithunzi futhi ulungise yonke into.
S.game.autumn.d: I-clicker yasekwindla enamaqabunga awayo, imibala efudumele, imisindo yemvelo ongayivula namabhodi abaholi. Asikho isikhathi, ayikho ingcindezi: vele uthephe uphumule.
S.studio.title: Abantu ababili, inhliziyo eyodwa
S.cd.title: U-Vlad ubhala ikhodi. U-Lilya uyaklama.
S.cd.text: Hudula isilayida: yile ndlela umdlalo ngamunye we-Lewydo uzalwa ngayo, kusukela kukhodi ka-Vlad kuya kumklamo ka-Lilya.
S.brand.more: Uphawu lwe-Lewydo: inhliziyo, ukushaya kwayo nephakethe
S.p.vlad.who: U-Vlad, umthuthukisi we-Android ne-LibGDX · isifunda sasePoltava, e-Ukraine
S.p.vlad.bio: Ubhala ikhodi kusukela ngo-2017: kuqala i-Java, ngemva konyaka i-Kotlin. Ungumthuthukisi wemidlalo wesikhathi esigcwele kusukela ngo-2021, kusukela kumfundi ofundela umsebenzi kuya ku-Team Lead esitudiyo semidlalo. Wonke umdlalo we-Lewydo wakhiwe nge-Kotlin ne-LibGDX, kuqala ku-Android.
S.p.lilya.bio: Amawebhusayithi, ukuklama izethulo nezithombe zezinkundla zokuxhumana kungumsebenzi wakhe omkhulu. Ngenxa ka-Vlad wangena nasekuklameni imidlalo, futhi wonke umdlalo we-Lewydo unesandla sakhe. *Phakathi kwethu: amawebhusayithi asewuthando lwakhe lokuqala* 😉
S.story.title: Indaba yethu kuze kube manje
S.story.1.d: U-Vlad ubhala ikhodi yakhe yokuqala. Ngemva konyaka uya ku-Kotlin futhi uhlala kuyo unomphela.
S.story.2.d: U-Vlad ushiya i-Military Institute of Telecommunications angene emidlalweni isikhathi esigcwele: umfundi ofundela umsebenzi, i-junior… kuze kube yi-Team Lead.
S.story.3.d: Umthuthukisi uhlangana nomklami. Isitudiyo asikazi ukuthi sikhona.
S.story.4.d: Usuku olufanayo, inyanga ehlukile — iqembu unomphela.
S.story.brand.d: U-Vlad wayehlala eqeda izindatshana zakhe ze-[Medium](https://veldan1202.medium.com/) mayelana ne-LibGDX, i-Android ne-Kotlin ngendlela efanayo: «Love what you do» nenhliziyo eluhlaza 💚. Lelo sayini laba uphawu lwethu.
S.story.imc.d: I-IMC: Idle Merge Cubes 2026 iphuma ku-Google Play.
S.story.idea.d: U-Vlad usebenza Emabuthweni Ahlomile ase-Ukraine. Ngolunye usuku ekuseni uvuka endlini lapho iyunithi yakhe ihlala khona ngesikhathi somsebenzi — enomqondo we-CubePix ekhanda.
S.story.od.d: Senza i-Orbit Dash futhi siyikhiphe ku-Google Play: imizila emibili, ukuthepha okukodwa.
S.story.proto.d: I-prototype yokuqala engadlalwa: imidwebo edumile yembulwa ikhyubhu ngekhyubhu.
S.story.pix.d: Siklama i-mascot ye-CubePix: ikhyubhu encane ebomvana, umdwebi onesigqoko se-beret nebhulashi. Igama lakhe ngu-Pix — Cube + Pix = CubePix, ngakho umdlalo uthwele igama lakhe.
S.story.live.d: U-Andrii (TikTok @malcev_ua) udlala i-Orbit Dash ku-TikTok LIVE — i-streamer yokuqala ukusakaza bukhoma nomdlalo wethu.
S.story.live.video: U-Andrii udlala i-Orbit Dash bukhoma ku-TikTok (isiqeshana semizuzwana engama-21)
S.story.live.thanks: Ngiyabonga, Andrii, ngokuba yi-streamer yami yokuqala esakaze bukhoma idlala umdlalo wami. Ngiyabonga kakhulu!
S.story.next.d: Iyeza kule nyanga — usuku oluqondile maduze.
S.contact.title: Masenze into ozoyithanda
S.contact.text: Unomqondo wokusebenzisana okuthakazelisayo, noma udinga umdlalo wekhwalithi ephezulu? Sibhalele — singajabula kakhulu ukuzwa kuwe.
S.nf.title: Leli khasi lilahlekile
S.nf.text: Kungenzeka ukuthi lisusiwe, noma kunephutha lokubhala esixhumanisini. Konke esikwenzayo kusekhasini lasekhaya.
S.music.label: Ingoma ethandwa ngu-Vlad: sombr — 12 to 12
S.od.levels: Lona ngumdlalo wangempela. Thepha isikrini udlale izinga ngokwakho.
S.cp:lead: Iphazili ezolile yabathanda ubuciko. Gcwalisa amakhyubhu ungqimba ngongqimba, futhi imidwebo edumile, izimangaliso zomhlaba namagugu amancane amaphikseli kuyaphila. Isithombe ngasinye siphetha ngelebula yemnyuziyamu nendaba yeqiniso.
S.cp:about: I-Lewydo yisitudiyo esincane semidlalo sabantu ababili sase-Ukraine. U-Vlad ubhala ikhodi, u-Lilya uyaklama. Ndawonye senza imidlalo esithanda ukuyidlala.
S.cp:how: Ikhyubhu yakho ikhombisa inombolo. Thepha amaseli anenombolo efanayo, noma uswayiphe phezu kwawo ngeketanga elilodwa elide: amaketanga anikeza amaphuzu amaningi.
S.cp:demo: Umdwebo ovela emnyuziyamu, uvezwa ungqimba ngongqimba
S.cp:pixName: Uyikhyubhu, futhi igama lakhe ngu-Pix. Kuhlanganise kokubili uthole i-CubePix: umdlalo uthwala igama lakhe.

strawberry.f: Isitrobheli asisona ijikijolo langempela: “imbewu” ngayinye encane kuso iyisithelo esihlukile esinembewu ngaphakathi.
